title: In a Game of Fools Without The Rules

sense.text:
“Every man from his youth is given to evil.” From the time we are born we are given to evil, and our enemies know it. That is why the raising up of children from their youth matters so much: what goes into their brains while they are developing builds the model of what they will become.

With that understanding Esau is able to put homosexuality in the cartoons and to steer your children, if you are not careful how you rear them up, in the direction he needs them to go, so that they provide sweat equity in the future.

That is why children of five years old, who probably can’t even add two and two, already know the lyrics to the What Up song, with the mother playing the music to help incite the demons. It is in them, and Esau knows that. It has to be understood what kind of trap we are in: children are the most sought after prey, to be turned into willing perpetrators of criminal behavior, wired into it by the television and the phones, until you watch your children transform into demons right before you.

“For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil.” The rulers, the powers that be, are not a terror to good works, meaning to those that keep the commandments of God. Even when we are persecuted for keeping them, it is not a terror to us, because we know what it is about. We are in captivity, but we are doing what God said to do, and the ones who mistreat us are going to have to answer to the Father for that.

There is a difference between suffering for righteousness’ sake and suffering as a murderer. Some of us are going to be locked up for doing what is right, and that takes a whole different mentality: I am being persecuted for a worthy cause, and the Lord is going to receive me because I did what was right. Suffering as a murderer, you are still going to get jacked up at the end, and you ain’t getting the kingdom.

“Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power?” We were not afraid of our power, the Most High, before. We broke the commandments. So the Lord said, since you did not want to hearken unto me, I am going to put this virulent beast over you, and when you mess up with him you are going to be judged by him, and he ain’t going to have no pity on you.

“but to the evil”: the rulers are a terror to those that do evil. The 20-year-old in the courtroom who got life is feeling that terror. He can’t say that the Lord is going to jack them up for what they are doing to him, because the reason he is getting jacked up is that he broke the laws of the Most High, suffering as a murderer. He broke down crying, because he is a wankster, not a gangster. What happened to all the gangsterism then, the What Up videos, the shoot them up, bang bang, make them hop double dutch? Nobody cares about your black ass once you are in the jail; whatever friends didn’t go down with you, your girlfriend, they have moved on.

That is where many of our sons and daughters are going who refuse to listen to their parents: if it ain’t jail, it is a pregnancy, a disease, a messed up life, a marriage riddled with alcohol abuse and domestic violence. That is why God gave children parents, to oversee that the daughters don’t get hooked up with the wrong type of brothers and the sons with the wrong type of sisters.

Those who will not hear will feel. Some of our children are going to have to go down this road.

“And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts”: the Most High revealed this to the ears of Isaiah. “Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die.” Till you die. Some of our people will not turn away from their wicked ways no matter how close they get to death.

precepts.why:
“Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets”: that is the gangs, on the corners doing nothing, looking for mischief to get into.

“as a wild bull in a net.” That is how they are. The parents can’t do nothing with them; they are like wild bulls.

Keep playing with these spirits and let the streets teach you. When you get jacked up, don’t look for me; I tried to tell you early and you didn’t want to hear it. That is how a father has to be. That is the reason the dads were chased out of the houses, because dads used to deal like that, while the mother says she is gonna take care of him, and he is in the house robbing, stealing, having sex on your bed, all kind of craziness, and you putting up with it.

sense.text:
“And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death”: because of the commandments. They don’t want to deal; they don’t want nobody telling them any damn thing.

“and the father the child.” The father delivering up the child to death means: son, I got to put your ass out of here. Call the police, get him out, because he is going to end up killing me, my wife, his sisters and brothers. I tried to teach my son not to do this, and he brought that What Up mess into the house and it is destroying the whole house. He got to go, because you ain’t going to mess around and get us killed.

“and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.” Keep playing with them spirits and that is what comes. A father tried to intervene in a fight on the street where his child was involved, and they turned around and killed him. If the children don’t kill their parents themselves, they will set their parents up to be murdered. Some of these kids are that wild. It ain’t popular to say it, but it is exactly what will happen.

The children have to know, because these politicians ain’t playing no more. Biden’s crime bill gave 53 death penalty offenses and called for taking the young people born out of wedlock, without parents, without supervision, off the street; now Trump is saying the same thing. They are all part of the game. They set up a system, and when we mess up in it they say kill us: the same language as slavery, either you pick up that bale or you get hung. The Most High set this up, and that is where we are at now.

precepts.why:
Delivering up to death shows what happens if you don’t fix it. If you trim your ways to seek love with your child, Christ is giving you a pattern here. If you don’t deliver that child unto Satan so that Satan can fix him, because you can’t do it (you tried it, you used the Bible, it’s not working), then it might pull you out of the truth.

“If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children.” Hate here means you are not trimming your ways against what the Lord said in order to benefit them, knowing that eventually that will pull you out of the truth. These are the persons closest to you, knit to your soul.

So when you are not delivering them up, you are enabling that behavior, and that behavior will drive them to keep doing what they are doing.

sense.text:
The smash and grabs, where they went into the malls and smashed the jewelry windows while people stood by and did nothing: the hoodlums thought they had some kind of power, not recognizing that it was part of the plan. Let them take something, let them get psychologically wired into thinking they can do anything they want. Lo and behold, the Lord was setting them up. A lot of people don’t understand that the Most High is going to get rid of a lot of our people, because they just refuse.

“do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same” Our enemies might not like what we are doing in resurrecting and straightening our people up, but can they really speak evil against it? No. Even certain of them will say, at least they are trying to curb things so as not to add to the mess that is out here.

“For he is the minister of God.” Esau, the powers that be, is the minister of God. In other words, he is God’s helper. That don’t sound good at all, but it is what it means. “For he is the minister of God to thee for good”: to you for your good, for you to straighten up.

“But if thou do that which is evil”: evil against God’s laws. It ain’t talking about us teaching the Bible or being persecuted for righteousness’ sake. But when you are out here stealing, raping, robbing, committing crimes, a murderer, God ain’t with that. “be afraid”: that is when the terrors are going to come upon you.

“for he beareth not the sword in vain.” He will use it. The police chase that turned into a shootout shows it: a car on its side, a man climbing out of it with a weapon in his hand shooting at police. That is somebody’s son. All the smash and grab, all the What Up, make them hop double dutch, bragged about on the radio and TV with little kids dancing to it, shaped in our people’s minds that they can’t be stopped, and it all ends up with this. The Lord gave the man with the badge all kinds of weaponry, because he is in God’s hands. Don’t get it wrong: the Lord is going to take him out too, in his time.

The Lord was serious when he said, you break my commandments, you are going to serve your enemies and get torn up until you repent. God is affecting every thing on this planet. He put Esau there because we did not want to do right; that is the only reason we are in this mess. Our way out is keeping the commandments. If we don’t, we are going to be subjected to things like this and worse.

precepts.why:
Some of your sons and daughters just don’t want to change, and like the Bible says, you have to deliver them to Satan, so that the house is spared, because your church is your house. If they are hellbent on destroying everything, you may love your baby and have his baby pictures, but you ain’t acting like my baby now, and it’s time for you to go.

“To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.” So that, hopefully, they can learn to get rid of that sin out of them and their spirit might be saved. That is why they call the system corrections. They don’t really get corrected, but sometimes you need that good ass whupping to make you straighten up. Tear up that ass and it might send a better message to the mind to straighten up, that the spirit might be saved.

We have to do that up in here too. Certain spirits don’t want to act right, judgment after judgment. Man, you got to go; woman, you got to go, because if you stay you are going to poison the rest of these brothers and sisters. Get your ass out. That is how fathers have to be. And when you put your foot down in your house, your own son and daughter might cause you to die, and you have to be aware of that.

If you don’t discipline your sons and daughters today, even with straight talk, they are going to be disciplined by the system: the cop with the 9 millimeter, the nightstick, the stun gun, the bullets, jail time, death. Better they learn it now while they have the chance.

sense.text:
A lot of people don’t like these parts of the Bible, because they require responsibility and discipline from us.

“In that day”: in the wilderness, right before we get to our kingdom. “there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David”: the fountain opened to the nation of Israel is the Bible, the laws of the Most High, the word, the water, opened up to the 12 tribes of Israel with Christ being there. “and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem”: the Israelites.

“for sin and for uncleanness”: lies, wickedness and evil are going to be opened up to be judged. This parallels the wilderness of Ezekiel, where he will plead with us face to face and cause us to pass under the rod. This is Christ talking: I will cause you, your sons and daughters, mothers and fathers, all of us, to pass under the rod of correction, and if we have not learned to keep God’s laws, that is the day you are going to die.

None of this evil is going to be in the kingdom. It is going to be purged out before we get there, the same way the Lord purged us when we came out of Egypt, 40 years in the wilderness until all them negroes got wiped out.

“I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land.” Who is the I? Christ. All that What Up, all that foolishness, is going to be dead. Some of our people are going to be spared when the bombs drop in this country just to be made examples in the wilderness.

“and they shall no more be remembered”, because they are going to be put to death. Somebody gets on a soapbox trying to persuade everybody to follow their evil, like Korah, Dathan and them in the days of Moses in Numbers, and those same spirits saved from the fire here are going to rise up again in the wilderness. Whatever they are teaching that ain’t in line with this Bible, they and everything they taught will be put to death, because when the Lord smites down the one teaching lies, everybody is going to drop it instantly and never talk about it again. That is going to be a good day.

“and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.” When a false prophet gets his head chopped off, everybody is going to know we ain’t following that. That is the biblical vengeance that is going to go down. Even where it says the heathen, it is talking about the wickedness of our people that got a heathenistic mindset; that sword is going to swing to kill their ass too. Everybody that is against the laws of the Most High is going to die that day.

“then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live.” Why would the parents do that? This goes back to the parents who have these terrible ass sons and terrible ass daughters that refuse to change, and who are putting their lives on the line for children that refuse to repent. The parents are going to say it because they will have already witnessed how Christ dealt with the rebellious. We seen that Christ ain’t playing, so you want to come up here and put my hand on the chopping block, your ass is going to die right now. I want evil gone.

“for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord”: you speak lies against what Christ said. “and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.” His own mother and father that literally gave birth to him shall take a sword and stick it through his body when he lies. That is what is going to get the attention; that is what works.

You can leave out of here all you want; you ain’t going to escape this. Everything that is said here is going to come to pass. So pray that our brothers and sisters get their minds right now, so that they don’t end up in the things that were shown in this class.

precepts.why:
None of this craziness is coming into the kingdom. “For without are dogs”: without the kingdom are the dogs, meaning the other nations.

“and sorcerers”: witchcraft. “and whoremongers”, “and murderers”, “and idolaters”: you ain’t getting the kingdom. And it is Christ saying it.

“and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.” If you even lie, damn it, your ass ain’t going in. Even liars, people that deal falsely: let the Lord mark your wicked ass. You ask them a question and they try to be slick with their answers. Some of our kids lie right in your face and act like the Lord ain’t hearing it, hiding certain things, lying by omission. That is what the commandment means when it says thou shalt not lie nor deal falsely: holding back. They know why you are asking, and they insult your intelligence and act like you ain’t asking what you are really asking. The Lord is marking that down, and the angels heard it.

This is the reason the parents are going to say “Thou shalt not live.” “But those mine enemies”: everybody that is against what Christ said is an enemy of Christ, and that includes our people.

“which would not that I should reign over them”: which would not that Christ, in his law, should rule over them. The fathers and mothers are trying to rule over their children to keep them from going astray, and the children say, I’m not having that, I’m doing my own thing, the hell with what you got to say, mama, daddy, that Bible. They refuse the correction of their fathers and mothers.

This is going to happen in the wilderness. Christ will be teaching the commandments face to face, and some will still tell him, I ain’t doing this, I ain’t doing that. Christ said, “bring hither, and slay them before me”: kill them right at my feet. That is what Jesus said. So once the parents see that Christ ain’t playing, now you understand why they will talk the way Zechariah 13 says.

sense.text:
Why do we have to go that far, all the way to the prison, to get people to see the reality, when they could simply stay away from it by following what the Most High gave the parents to give them?

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.” “Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)”. Do you think children can go against this and expect to be spared by the Lord’s sword, which is Esau and his system?

The reason we were even brought over here is that we disobeyed. We are not even supposed to be here; we are not supposed to be underneath these people. Some think it just had to be, but it did not.

“For thus saith the Lord”: this is about us, and why we are in this situation. “Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup”: that is us. We were not supposed to drink of this cup of destruction, of everything we are going through, because we are God’s people, his children, his heirs, his firstborn, the whole nation. Yet we “have assuredly drunken”. These things happened to us.

“and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished?” Now he is pointing to the nations. “thou shalt not go unpunished.” There is a payback for what they are doing to us. Even though my people were messing up and I had to burn them, you that did it are going to pay for it. The white man and the nations that did this evil to us will not go unpunished.

“but thou shalt surely drink of it”: they shall surely drink of the captivity, the punishment, the slavery. They are going to drink all of it.

precepts.why:
“For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen”: near upon all the nations. “as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee”: as the nations have done to us, it shall be done to them. That is reap what you sow. “thy reward shall return upon thine own head”: the terror and the evil they did to us is going to happen to them by the hands of his people Israel.

But it will be by the hands of those that keep his commandments. The ones that continue in disobedience are not going to get nothing; they are going to be done away with, and we will never hear from those spirits again.

“For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain”: as you have put your captivity and your evil upon my people, even though they deserved it, “so shall all the heathen drink continually”. All the nations shall drink slavery continually: the captivity, getting their heads chopped off, their babies smashed against the rocks, the sword executing vengeance upon them. The saints are the ones that will get that opportunity. It is going to be a beautiful thing when we get that revenge.

But that does not let our wicked children off the hook. The ones of us that don’t learn this gospel and do what the Bible says in sincerity will be wiped out, so don’t put yourselves on the chopping block for wicked ass sons and wicked ass daughters who refuse to repent. Your own children may want you dead for standing up for the word of the Lord, so be prepared mentally, psychologically and spiritually for anything. Don’t cow down and trim your ways to seek love, thinking they are going to be nice to you; Satan will get in them and still cause you to be put to death.

“and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been”: as though they were never a nation again. They shall be like we are now, acting like we were never a nation, never a people.

sense.text:
The honour of leadership and parents has to be at the forefront of the young men’s minds; without it they end up like the young men in the courtroom. Honour is moral integrity, honesty and a strong code of conduct, and the high respect a person earns through their actions, or a special privilege.

“For God commanded, saying”: this is not a commandment that man stated; it is what God commanded. “Honour thy father and mother”: have moral integrity, honesty and a strong code of conduct toward your father and your mother, and give them that high respect.

“and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.” That is the judgment for not honouring your father and mother.

precepts.why:
“Honour thy father with thy whole heart.” The root of integrity is integer, meaning whole: honour them with the whole heart. “and forget not the sorrows of thy mother”: the troubles of raising you, that she had to carry you for nine months and give birth to you.

“Remember that thou wast begotten of them”: remember that you came from them. “and how canst thou recompense them the things that they have done for thee?” How can you pay them back for bringing you into this world? You can’t. They did it because they had to; that was their responsibility. So your responsibility as the child is to honour them, if for nothing else than that they brought you into this world and reared you up.

“Glory not in the dishonour of thy father; for thy father’s dishonour is no glory unto thee.” This is for the older ones too, who may have parents that are not in the truth. You might think that because your parent is not in the truth you don’t have to give them the respect of a parent. That is not what the Lord said. It is nothing to glory in that the Lord called you and your father or mother is not in this truth.

“For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father; and a mother in dishonour is a reproach to the children.” “My son, help thy father in his age”: you are to be an aid to your parent when they reach a certain age, and not only when you feel like it. “and grieve him not as long as he liveth.”

“And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when thou art in thy full strength.” We are the only nation of people that don’t take care of our elders; other nations take care of theirs, while our children put their parents in a nursing home and pay somebody else to watch after them. That is no way to honour your parents. To have your parents and be able to talk with them, and not respect them, is a problem, especially to one who went through the system with no mother and father.

When you are in your full strength, be patient, because the example the elders set is what the young men see. They are the goalposts. If we are falling off, the only other thing the young men see is what was shown on the screen in this class, and that is their end result. We can’t have that.

sense.text:
“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.” There is beauty in being elite, in being clean, in being upright and perfect. Don’t let anybody entice you out of that. The main framers of that perfection are your parents, when they are all right in the Lord. That is why the Bible says to obey your parents in the Lord.

That is the warning to the young sisters and the young brothers. If you go the wrong way, no tears will be shed for you. You have been warned; you have righteousness all around you, and if you don’t want to walk with it you will feel the consequences, and be delivered to Satan, because the flock has to keep going.
“That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.” The Most High means that.

“And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath.” This is how fathers provoke their children to wrath: by coddling them, by covering for them when they do evil. Let that judgment roll on that ass. If you get in the way of it and coddle them, you are going to embolden them to ultimately put you to damn death.

“but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord”: the warnings of the Lord.

“My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.” That sister was enticed to follow that evil, and the brothers were enticed to follow that evil. Consent thou not: don’t agree with it, walk away from it. Be strong enough to walk away from so-called peer pressure, you young men of valor and you young sisters, because you get tempted all the time.

And when you hear evil, especially if it is in the congregation, expose their ass. The Bible tells you to tell on their ass. You are saving their life, and yours. They would rather be dealt with by us than by the penal system.

“If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause”: this is what they did when they hunted that boy down. They plotted together; they said, let us wait and set him up, without a reason. “Let us swallow them up alive as the grave”: let us kill them. But there were cameras everywhere, and all kind of technology following every move they made, and they got caught thinking they were slick.

“We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil”: we shall get our name in lights, on the Instagram, because we took him out. That is how they were celebrating. “Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse”: let’s get paid together, the smash and grabs.

“My son, walk not thou in the way with them”: my son or my daughter, don’t walk in that way. That is what you parents are trying to tell them. Don’t follow that. “refrain thy foot from their path.” And if you hear evil, especially coming from in the congregation, tell on their ass. It will save their lives and save yours.

“For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.” That is our people, running to evil and making haste to shed blood.

precepts.why:
Alcohol plays a lot in these things. Some of the young girls running out of this truth get with some dude and start drinking, and the same on the men’s side. Alcohol is a drug, any way you spell it. It removes your inhibitions and emboldens you to do things you normally would not do, because your common sense would have kicked in. It mentions alcohol, so it is talking about that, and other things.

“Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink.” This is enticing through envy. In school there were sisters that were pure, not running around with boys, and brothers that were straight with the books and did not play in the mess. Then a group of women, or a group of hooligans, sees them shining like a diamond and hates it, because chances are that sister has parents that care for her and watch over her, and these other ratchet demons don’t. You ain’t cool if you ain’t on our team. You are supposed to love thy neighbour, not want them intoxicated, where they can’t think properly or recognize evil.

“that puttest thy bottle to him”: they befriend your daughters and your sons and get them to drink a little, to show they are sociable now: I didn’t know you was this cool, I thought you was a square. Now they are in the batch, and they start lying to you as parents and not telling the fathers and mothers nothing. They don’t want the rest of the thugs; they want the pure women and the straight brothers, to corrupt them. That is what happened to Dinah: everybody in the town wanted her defiled and had her set up.

“and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!” They want to see your daughter drunk, lose her inhibitions and every thing else, until she is a full participant in the evil, while they sit back and watch. The nakedness is their sin: look at you now, you ain’t no better than us. Once she is pregnant, got a disease, recorded at some party, or once your son has messed up his life and gets locked up or killed, they don’t care about them after that. Another one bites the dust. A man graduated with honors, a four-year scholarship, well on his way, went back to a party to celebrate with his homies, and they ended up killing him.

It is the same spirit that wants to destroy IUIC: wicked camps that want to see us in the same evil they are in, and even lie on us and imagine things to say we ain’t no better than them. We ain’t joining with your wicked asses. They would love to put us in the mud with them, and that is what they want to do to your sons and your daughters.

If you are in a game of fools, you don’t understand the rules. The rules are: obey the commandments of the Lord, and you can escape these things. Think you are going to do something else, and you will suffer the consequences.
